context: This study is fictional. Assess each claim using only the supplied evidence.

samples.summary: Researchers measured the mean change in a laboratory susceptibility score in genetic background G1. Its mean change was -2 units. Lower scores represent greater measured susceptibility. Backgrounds G2 and G3 were not measured. No patient outcomes were assessed.
samples.claim: The measured mean score decreased in G1.
samples.label: SUPPORTED
samples.rationale: The reported mean change in G1 is negative.
